text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Uwoooh! We finally get to see it! 
'Justice☆All-Stars VS The Villain Legion!'

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
My blood is boiling~♪ Carrotman, Prify... 
a grand gathering of all kinds of heroes 
of justice! There's no doubt it'll be a 
masterpiece!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, haven't you guys seen the trailer~? 
The villain corps this time is super 
strong~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
W-What did you say!? Carrotman never gives 
up, no matter who he's up against!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure about that~? In the preview, 
every single hero got totally blown away!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Too bad for you! This time, evil shall 
prevail~~~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh, grr...! Evil was j-just a hair 
away from victory...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh dear... Please don't cry so.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I am not crying, nope!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... An ally of justice can't really 
root for an evil organization, but...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I understand how you feel, Windy-san. 
If PuriFai lost, even I'd be bawling my 
eyes out.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ugaaaah! Shuuuut uuup!! Windy-chan doesn't 
need your pity!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
If that's how it is, I'm taking it out on 
someone! I'm gonna go spoil the ending for 
people who haven't seen it yet!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"What!? I won't let you get away with 
something so awful!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
As a princess, I cannot overlook this. 
Princess Full-Power Intervention! Here I 
go!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh! I'm not scared of that! When I 
say I'm gonna do it, I do it~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Are you truly certain about this?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
If it gets spoiled, the villain king's 
final plot twist will be completely 
ruined!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Nani...!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
King Villain's tragic past was finally 
revealed! And shielding his allies to the 
bitter end—what an unexpected demise! Even 
for an enemy, it was truly magnificent...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! He was a bad guy, but it 
really touched me! To think people won't 
be able to enjoy that anymore...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
N-No way, that's not okay! I want everyone 
to know how cool King the Villain is!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I won't give any spoilers after all, 
noda... I want everyone to watch it 
properly, noda!
